description: Due-diligence forensics API for AI agents: token verdict cards, wallet trust screens, pre-trade settle-safe screens for tokenized equities, and composed due-diligence memos. Pay-per-call x402 v2, USDC on Base.

resources.description: Directory endpoint: free service card + all endpoint/pricing metadata, x402-routes to every paid endpoint
Main API: info free; verdict/settlesafe $0.02; token/wallet/canton/linea $0.05; memo $0.25-$0.35

decisions.question: Is this token real, alive and safe to touch?
decisions.free_trial: add trial=1 for free daily calls per IP
decisions.answers_in: one call: grade, risk flags, roast, data_quality

decisions.question: Can I accept or settle against this token or wallet right now?
decisions.free_trial: add trial=1 for free daily calls per IP
decisions.answers_in: one call: paused / fee-trap / clawback and an overall pass or fail

decisions.question: Does this wallet actually hold what it claims?
decisions.free_trial: add trial=1 for 3 free calls per day per IP
decisions.answers_in: one call: reconciled holdings with an explicit holdings_status

bundle.why: shortest path from an unknown token to a decision

freeStart.what: free metered key, no card and no signer
freeStart.quota: 10,000 cached verdict calls per calendar month

lifecycleNote: verdict, settlesafe and wallet are the promoted decisions. options, derivs and the tokenized-equity routes are live and priced but not promoted.
